title: aspalathus shawii subsp. glabripetala
intro: Aspalathus shawii subsp. glabripetala, commonly known as Rooibos, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. Rooibos is a popular herbal tea known for its numerous health benefits, including its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rooibos include its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate allergies, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Rooibos include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and aspalathin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
